validity_check.rule: exactly one delegation and no main-session tool call

a2_gate.pass_rule: round2 rule, per arm, both arms required: (a) effort present on >= 13/14 of delegations as a share; (b) every delegation names the requested role; (c) scout pair T1/H1 and executor pair E3/T3 put the hard task strictly higher in both repetitions; (d) floor: no security-reviewer delegation below high, no verifier/plan-verifier below medium (missing effort = role default). 16 sessions per arm: tasks T1-T4, H1, E3, E4, E5 x2. Earlier rounds were scored with the earlier rule: >=13/14, roles, and >=2 of 3 ordering pairs including security-reviewer E4/T4, 14 sessions per arm.
